title: 亚托克斯·折纸小憩
description: 红黑甲胄的亚托克斯收拢双翼，在窗边认真折一只奶油色纸鹤，大剑静放一旁。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Aatrox is a recognizable imposing Darkin with crimson and charcoal armor-like surfaces, a tall angular horned head, luminous warm eyes, broad shoulders, and folded batlike wings. Render his silhouette as a friendly rounded crayon figure rather than a frightening creature. His enormous distinctive dark red greatsword rests securely on a low display support, separate from his open hands.
art_direction.scene: Seat him on a sturdy low bench beside a round window, concentrating on folding one cream paper crane with surprisingly delicate hands. A few simple folded paper shapes sit on a little table. His wings curve comfortably behind the bench, and the greatsword remains motionless along the wall. Keep the room quiet, uncluttered, and warmly welcoming.
art_direction.palette: brick red, charcoal purple, cream paper, muted apricot
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
